Rae L: Passing CobaltBridge to CS — closed yesterday. Deal notes: Private deployment (VPC), US region, Okta SSO, high-volume nightly embeddings job, observed CPU and queue spikes during parallel imports. Renewal Nov 2026 (8mo). Main contact: aarav@cobaltbridge.ai. Sales doc: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/CB-789>. Please own onboarding and triage. @Omar K can you take this?

Omar K: Ill take it. Quick asks: do we have sample ingestion job, and did they use KV cache? Also need procurement contact for potential credits if reliability impacts renewal.

Rae L: I uploaded the sanitized manifest and procurement contact in the share. Marco(aarav) will send IdP metadata by EOD. Sales flagged renewal risk 7/10 due to performance sensitivity.

Omar K: Plan: 1) 30m kickoff this week 2) ENG ticket to repro spikes 3) SUP ticket for monitoring + alerting 4) 1-hour ops enablement session after kickoff.

HandoffBot: Created task "cobaltbridge-kickoff" (ID ONB-904). Tickets created: ENG-1102, SUP-523.

Sofia V: Ill take ENG-1102. Hypothesis: connection pool or worker concurrency saturating token-generation processes during parallel runs. Need sample concurrency, batch size, and whether they stream responses.

Ben H: Ill own SUP-523 — will add dashboard panels (CPU, 5xx, token-queue depth, latency percentiles) and draft an incident runbook for bulk-import failures.

Omar K: Owners: CS lead Omar K; ENG owner Sofia V; Support lead Ben H; Enablement Omar K. Action items: - Omar: schedule kickoff + invite (due 2026-04-05) - Sofia: repro & config recs (48h) - Ben: dashboards + runbook (72h) - Rae: follow up with customer for IdP + confirmation of import window (EOD)

Sofia V: Will run a staged import from our env simulating their manifest. If we hit limits, options: temporary ingress-burst, increase worker backoff with jitter, or suggestion to shard imports. Will post repro notes in ENG-1102.

Ben H: SUP-523 blocked on sample job to tune alerts. Also adding a throttling alert at 1% 5xx over 5m.

Omar K: Ill prepare a short operator runbook that includes recommended batch sizes, KV cache tips, and fallback model mapping. Ill also add a 30/60 day renewal checkpoint to CRM.

Rae L: Sales can discuss a remediation credit window if needed. Thanks team :handshake: Ping me if you need procurement details.
